colour.title: Color Palette
colour.addHint: Adds slot {{index}} as a copy of the primary colour.
colour.full: The palette already holds {{max}} colours, the most this style allows.
colour.removeHint: Removes slot {{index}}. Slots are numbered without gaps, so only the last one can go.
colour.inUse: Slot {{index}} is painted on {{count}} pixels, so it was kept. Paint over them first, then remove it.
colour.keepOne: A palette keeps at least one colour.
colour.grid: Swatches. Left click picks the primary colour, right click the secondary.
colour.noRamps: This palette has no ramps yet.
